DONGNIDEFENSE-DONGNI_MEANING.title: Dongni Meaning
DONGNIDEFENSE-DONGNI_MEANING.pages.INITI:
A man calling himself Anthony Giovannetti has found you. He heard that you have been playing small decks, and he is here to warn you: stop playing small decks, or he will send someone after you.
What do you do?
Gain 【Dongni Strike】【Dongni Defense】, enchant a card with 【Clone】, and gain the relic 【Bing Bong】.
DONGNIDEFENSE-DONGNI_MEANING.pages.REFUS: You ignored Anthony and deleted whatever you wanted. So Anthony sent someone after you.
DONGNIDEFENSE-DONGNI_MEANING.pages.PUNCH: You killed Anthony with a single punch, but somehow his ghost lingers...
